picture-pairs.name: Mifananidzo miviri
picture-pairs.description: Mutambo wakasununguka, wakanyorova wokubatanidza wevanhu vane dementia. Mifananidzo mikuru inoramba ichioneka, hapana nguva kana mapoinzi, uye unosarudza matairo 4 kusvika 12.
picture-pairs.short: Wana mifananidzo miviri yakafanana. Mifananidzo inogona kuramba ichioneka.
picture-pairs.intro: Tepfa mufananidzo, wobva watepfa wakafanana nawo. Mifananidzo inoramba ichioneka nekusingaperi, saka hapana chinofanira kuyeuka. Kana mifananidzo miviri ichienzana, inowana muganhu wegoridhi nechiratidzo chekuti zvakanaka.
howTo: Sarudza kuti mangani matairo ashandiswe. Mana mana akanyorova kuti utange.
Tepfa mufananidzo wipi zvawo. Unowana muganhu wegoridhi.
Tepfa mufananidzo wakafanana nawo. Mapaizi anoramba akabatana nechiratidzo chekuti zvakanaka.
Kana mifananidzo miviri isiyana, hapana chakaipa chinoitika. Tepfa zvakare kana mose mwakagadzirira.
Ita "Mifananidzo yakavanzwa" chete kana imi vese mafarira mutambo wechinyakare wemifananidzo yakaturikwa pasi.
tips: Taurai mazita emifananidzo pamwe chete muchitaura nezvayo: "Kapu jena rakatsvuka. Imi munoda mukaka mutii wenyu here?"
Regai munhu unomutarisira aite kutepfa, kunyange zvichitora nguva. Ratidzai nechigunwe panzvimbo pekutepfera munhu.
Gara nematairo mana kwenguva yose inofadza. Matairo akawanda ndiko kusarudza, kwete mwero wekusvika.
Pedza muchiri kufarira. Mutambo mumwe chete wakakwana.

faq.a: Kwete. Hapana wachi, mapoinzi, kauntara yemafambiro kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira chero nguva, uye kumira pakati pazvo ndiyo nzira yakanaka yekupedza.

Kuramba mifananidzo ichioneka kunoita kuti mutambo ube wekutarira nekubatanidza, kwete wekuyeuka. Vazhinji vanowana izvi zvakanyarara. Unogona kuchinja kuita mifananidzo yakavanzwa nekutepfa kamwe chete kana uchida.
Hongu, hauna mari, uye hapana akaundi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Unoshanda mubhurawuza yewebhu pafoni, tablet kana kombiyuta.

faq.q: Tinogona kushandisa mifananidzo yedu yemhuri here?
faq.a: Hongu. Edza Mifananidzo yemhuri, inokutendai kusarudza mifananidzo kubva kudhivhaisi yenyu. Mifananidzo inoramba mubhurawuza yenyu uye haitumirwi.

find-the-same.name: Tsvaga yakafanana
find-the-same.seoTitle: Tsvaga Mufananidzo Wakafanana: Mutambo Wakanyorova weDementia
find-the-same.description: Mufananidzo mumwe pamusoro, miviri kusvika mina pasi. Tepfa wakafanana. Mutambo wakasununguka, wakanyorova wemifananidzo wevanhu vane dementia, usina nguva.
find-the-same.short: Tarira mufananidzo uri kumusoro utepfe wakafanana uri pasi.
find-the-same.intro: Mufananidzo mumwe chete unogara pamusoro pe-screen. Pasi pawo pane vaviri, vatatu kana vana. Tepfa wakafanana. Ndiko kusarudza kumwe chete panguva, nenzvimbo yakawanda yekutaura.
howTo: Sarudza mifananidzo miviri, mitatu kana mina yekusarudza. Miviri ndiyo iri nyore.
Tarirai mufananidzo wepamusoro pamwe chete.
Tepfa mufananidzo wakafanana pasi. Unoratidzwa nechiratidzo chekuti zvakanaka pamwe nemashoko mashoma akanyorova.
Kana mufananidzo usina kufanana wakatepfwa, mutambo unongotaura zita rawo uye unomirira. Tora nguva yako.
Tepfa "Mufananidzo unotevera" kana mugadzirira mumwe.
tips: Taurai nezvemufananidzo wega wega musati masarudza: mavara, maumbirwo, kwamungaiona.
Sarudzo mbiri hadzisi "nyore kwazvo". Chinangwa chiri kuva nenguva inofadza, kwete kupikisana.
Kana kutepfa kuri kunetesa, munhu anogona kuratidza nechigunwe uye imi mugatepfera.

faq.a: Kwete. Hapana wachi, mapoinzi, kauntara yemafambiro kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira chero nguva, uye kumira pakati pazvo ndiyo nzira yakanaka yekupedza.

faq.q: Chii chinoitika kana mufananidzo usiri kufanana watepfwa?
faq.a: Hapana chinonetesa. Hapana bhuza, chikalo chitsvuku kana kugwedezeka. Mutambo unotaura zita remufananidzo wakatepfwa uye unomirira kutepfa kwakatevera.
Hongu, hauna mari, uye hapana akaundi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Unoshanda mubhurawuza yewebhu pafoni, tablet kana kombiyuta.

shadow-match.name: Kubatanidza mumvuri
shadow-match.seoTitle: Mutambo Wekubatanidza Mumvuri weDementia: Wepamhepo Wakasununguka
shadow-match.description: Mumvuri wakasviba pamusoro, mifananidzo miviri kusvika mina pasi. Tepfa mufananidzo unoita mumvuri. Mutambo wakasununguka, wakanyorova wemumvuri weDementia, usina nguva.
shadow-match.intro: Kubatanidza mumvuri ibasa rakajairika kubva kumapepa ekudzidza, asi pano une mifananidzo mikuru uye hapana chekudhinda. Mumvuri wakapfava uri pamusoro pe-screen uye mifananidzo miviri, mitatu kana mina inomirira pasi. Tepfa iyo inoita mumvuri. Maumbirwo akaita sebhasikoro, humbwe kana kapu anoreruka kutaura nazvo.
howTo: Sarudza mifananidzo miviri, mitatu kana mina yekusarudza. Miviri ndiyo iri nyore.
Tarirai mumvuri pamwe chete. Ndiro rei? Rakareba here kana rakatenderera?
Tepfa mufananidzo unoita mumvuri. Zita rawo rinoonekwa pasi pemumvuri.
Kana mufananidzo usina kufanana wakatepfwa, mutambo unongotaura zita rawo uye unomirira. Tora nguva yako.
Tepfa "Mumvuri unotevera" kana mugadzirira mumwe.
tips: Tevedzera mugoro womumvuri nechigunwe uye taurai nezvechimiro chawo.
Kana mumvuri wakaoma nhasi, chinja uite Tsvaga yakafanana, apo mifananidzo yakafanana.
Taurai nezvemufananidzo wawanikwa: "Taive nemumbure wakadaro."

faq.a: Kwete. Hapana wachi, mapoinzi, kauntara yemafambiro kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira chero nguva, uye kumira pakati pazvo ndiyo nzira yakanaka yekupedza.

faq.q: Kuenzanisa mimvuri kunonaka here kune vanhu vane dementia?
faq.a: Kungava basa rinofadza uye rakareruka kune vamwe vanhu, kunyanya panguva dzekutanga. Zvimiro zviri nyore kuzivikanwa kupfuura mazwi. Chiri chekufadzwa nekutaurirana, kwete bvunzo, uye hachirapi kana kudzikisa dementia. Kana chichikonzera kuvhiringidzwa, edzai Wana zvakafanana kana kungotarisa mifananidzo pamwe chete.

faq.q: Chii chinoitika kana mufananidzo usiri wakanaka wakapawanwa?
faq.a: Hapana chinoipisa. Hapana bhuza, chikwereti chitsvuku kana kutsikirira. Mutambo unotaura zita remufananidzo wakapawanwa uye unomirira kupawanwa kwakatevera.

faq.q: Chiri mahara here, uye ndinoda kunyoresa here?
faq.a: Hongu, chiri mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Chinoshanda mubhurawuza yeweb pafoni, tabuleti kana komputa.

sort-together.name: Kurongedza pamwe chete
sort-together.seoTitle: Mutambo Wekurongedza weDementia: Rongedzai Pamwe Chete
sort-together.h1: Rongedzai Pamwe Chete: Basa Rekurongedza Mifananidzo
sort-together.description: Pawa mufananidzo, wobva wapawa dengu rinoenderana nawo: kicheni kana gadheni, michero kana mhuka. Basa rakanyarara uye mahara rekurongedza vanhu vane dementia.
sort-together.short: Isai mufananidzo wega wega mudengu rawo: kicheni kana gadheni, nezvimwe.
sort-together.intro: Kurongedza ibasa rakajairika rinofadza rezuva nezuva, senge kuisa zvinhu zvakatengwa kana kubatanidza masokisi. Pawa mufananidzo, wobva wapawa dengu paunofanira kuuisa. Hapana kukurumidza uye hapana kukanganisa kwakaipa.
howTo: Sarudzai musoro: kicheni negadheni, michero nemhuka, kana imba norwendo.
Pawa mufananidzo. Unowana mupendero wegoridhe.
Pawa dengu rinoenderana nawo. Mufananidzo unopinda mudengu iroro.
Kana riri rimwe dengu, mutambo unotaura izvi zvakanyatsonaka uye unomirira.
Kana mifananidzo yose yarongedzwa, tarisai madengu pamwe chete.
tips: Mupiro wechokwadi hauzivikanwi nekukasira. Kana munhu akati chirongwa chekuthirira chiri mukicheni, mubvunze kuti sei. Unogona kuwana nyaya yakanaka.
Shandisai mifananidzo sechiyeuchidzo: "Makanyatsobereka chii mugadheni renyu?"
Kurongedza zvinhu zvechokwadi, senge mipuni nemakiti kana bhatani nerudzi, ibasa rakanaka rekutevedzera kure neskirini.

faq.a: Kwete. Hapana wachi, mapoinzi, kauntarai yekufamba, kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi, uye kumira pakati pebasa hakuzoshaya kuti ndiyo nzira yakanaka yekupedzisa.
Vanhu vazhinji vanofarira kurongedza nekuti rinoita sebasa rinobatsira uye rakajairika. Zvakare zviri nyore kutaura nezvemifananidzo sezvamunenge muchiita.

faq.q: Chiri mahara here, uye ndinoda kunyoresa here?
faq.a: Hongu, chiri mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Chinoshanda mubhurawuza yeweb pafoni, tabuleti kana komputa.

picture-puzzle.name: Puzzle yemufananidzo
picture-puzzle.description: Jigsaw yakareruka paintaneti yevanhu vane dementia: zvidimbu 4 kana 9 zvikuru, mufananidzo wose unoramba uchioneka, uye unopawa zvidimbu zviviri kuti zvichinjane.
picture-puzzle.short: Pawa zvidimbu zviviri kuti zvichinjane kusvikira mufananidzo wazara.
picture-puzzle.intro: Mufananidzo wakanaka unocheketwa kuva zvidimbu zvina kana zvipfumbamwe zvikuru uye unosanganiswa. Mufananidzo wose unoramba uchioneka sechiratidzo. Pawa chidimbu chimwe, wobva wapawa chimwe, zvinochinja nzvimbo. Hapana kudhonza kunoda.
howTo: Sarudzai mufananidzo uye zvidimbu 4 kana 9. Zvina ndiko kutanga kunyorova.
Tarisai mufananidzo wose pamusoro.
Pawa chidimbu, wobva wapawa nzvimbo chinofanira kuenda. Zvidimbu zviviri zvinochinja.
Zvidimbu zviri munzvimbo yazvo zvinowana chiratidzo chiduku chekutarisa.
Mufananidzo wazara, fadzai pamwe chete, wobva wasarudza imwe.
tips: Kupawa zvidimbu zviviri kuti zvichinjane kunonyorova kupfuura kudhonza kune vazhinji.
Taurai nezvemufananidzo sezvunenge uchiumbika: "Ipapo pane denga rakatsvuka."
Puzzle yemapuwa chaiyo ine zvidimbu 12 kusvika ku24 zvikuru ndiyo yakanaka patafura zvakare.

faq.a: Kwete. Hapana wachi, mapoinzi, kauntarai yekufamba, kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi, uye kumira pakati pebasa hakuzoshaya kuti ndiyo nzira yakanaka yekupedzisa.
Kwete. Pawa chidimbu chimwe, wobva wapawa chimwe, zvinochinja nzvimbo. Izvi zvinonyanya kuita nyore kana ruoko rwakadedera kana paskirini diki.

faq.q: Chiri mahara here, uye ndinoda kunyoresa here?
faq.a: Hongu, chiri mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Chinoshanda mubhurawuza yeweb pafoni, tabuleti kana komputa.

finish-the-saying.name: Pedzisa mataurirwo
finish-the-saying.description: Mataurirwo akajairwa ane izwi rekupedzisira risina, akadai sekuti "Mari yakachengetwa mari yakawanikwa ___". Dzvanya sarudzo kana uratidze mugumo, wobva wataura nazvo.
finish-the-saying.short: Pedzisai mataurirwo akajairwa pamwe chete, wobva wataura nazvo.
finish-the-saying.intro: Mataurirwo ekare anowanzo kuzivikanwa kwehupenyu hwose. Kadhi yega yega inoratidza mutauro wakajairwa une izwi rekupedzisira risina, sarudzo nhatu, uye bhatani rekuti "Ratidza mugumo". Mushure memugumo, mubvunzo unoyevedza unokurudzira kutaurirana.
howTo: Verengai mataurirwo pamwe chete nemuzwi.
Dzvanya izwi rinopedzisa, kana dzvanya "Ratidza mugumo".
Verengazve mataurirwo ose wobva wataura nazvo uchishandisa mubvunzo.
Dzvanya "Mataurirwo anotevera" kana muri pamhanza.
tips: Verengai zvishoma nezvishoma uye regai kumira pamberi peizwi rekupedzisira. Kazhinji vanhu vanotaura kuzvo musati mapedza.
Kana munhu akapa mugumo wakasiyana, fadzai. Mamwe mazviro emataurirwo anosiyana nemhuri kana nedunhu.
Mubato, munhu mumwe anoverenga uye vese vanobatanidza mugumo.

faq.a: Kwete. Hapana kloko, mamaki, kauntarai yezvamakaita kana kukundikana. Imi munogona kumira panguva ipi neipi, uye kumira pakati ndiyo nzira yakanaka yekupedzisa.
Mutambo unoratidza mugumisiro wakajairwa uye unopfuura kuenderera mukutaurirana. Hapana mamaki, uye mhinduro yakasiyana yakanaka.
Hongu, mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Zvinoshanda pawebhusaiti pafoni, pathabhureti kana pakombiyuta.

word-search.name: Tsvagiridzo yemashoko akakura
word-search.seoTitle: Tsvagiridzo Yemashoko Akakura Yedementia, Anogona Kudhindwa
word-search.description: Tsvagiridzo yemashoko yakakura yemahara yevakuru nevanhu vane dementia. Mashoko mashoma, matsamba akakura, mashoko achiverengwa kurutivi kana pasi chete. Tamba paintaneti kana udhinde.
word-search.short: Matsamba akakura, mashoko mashoma, achiverengwa kurutivi kana pasi chete. Udhindewo zvakare.
word-search.intro: Gride diki ine matsamba akakura uye mashoko mashoma chete, ese achiverengwa kurutivi kana pasi. Tinya tsamba rekutanga reshoko, wobva watinya tsamba rekupedzisira. Unoda pepa? Dhinda puzzle nyowani nekudzvanya kamwe chete.
howTo: Sarudza musoro wenyaya uye saizi yegride.
Tarisa rondedzero yemashoko. Mashoko anoverengwa kurutivi (kubva kuruboshwe kuenda kurudyi) kana pasi (kubva kumusoro kuenda pasi).
Tinya tsamba rekutanga reshoko, wobva watinya tsamba rekupedzisira.
Shoko rawanikwa rinoratidzwa nemavara uye rinobviswa paruzivo rwemashoko.
Tinya "Dhinda puzzle iyi" kuti mutambe pachipepa nepenseri kana marker.
tips: Ratidza shoko paruzivo rwemashoko, mutsvage tsamba rekutanga pamwe chete.
Pachipepa, highlighter iri nyore kubata kupfuura pensiri.
Taurai nezvemashoko enyaya. Mashoko emichero inzira yakanaka yekupinda mundangariro dzekukohwa, kubika kana musika.

faq.a: Kwete. Hapana kloko, mamaki, kauntarai yezvamakaita kana kukundikana. Imi munogona kumira panguva ipi neipi, uye kumira pakati ndiyo nzira yakanaka yekupedzisa.
Hongu. Tinya "Dhinda puzzle iyi" kuti udhinde gride yazvino nemagwaro akakura, rondedzero yemashoko iri pasi pawo. Puzzle nyowani yega yega inosiyana.
Hongu, mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Zvinoshanda pawebhusaiti pafoni, pathabhureti kana pakombiyuta.

coloring.name: Mapeji ekupenda nemavara
coloring.seoTitle: Mapeji Ekupenda Nemavara Evanhu Vane Dementia (Mahara)
coloring.description: Mapeji ane nyore, ekuvakuru ane nzvimbo dzakakura: tinya ruvara, wobva watinya chikamu chemifananidzo. Hapana kusvibisa, hapana mavara asina kunaka, uye peji rega rega rinogona kudhindwa mahara.
coloring.short: Tinya ruvara, wobva watinya chikamu chemifananidzo. Udhindewo mapeji.
coloring.intro: Mapeji ane mifananidzo mikuru, yakapfava: ruva rakamira mumudziyo, imba, kapu yetii, gonyeri uye chikepe chemhepo. Tinya ruvara, wobva watinya chikamu chemifananidzo kuti uchizadze. Hapana mavara akanganisika.
howTo: Sarudza peji.
Tinya ruvara. Ruvara rega rega rine zita rarwo rakanyorwa pariri.
Tinya chikamu chemifananidzo kuti uchizadze neruvara urwo.
Chinja pfungwa yako nguva ipi neipi nekuzadzazve.
Tinya "Dhinda peji iri" kuti uwane peji risina chinhu chekupenda nepenseri kana makirayoni.
tips: Pana mavara maviri chete kuti musarudze pakati pawo kana kusarudza kwacho kwakaoma.
Miti yepepuru nezuva rebhuruu zvinofarirwa. Ndiko kunakidzwa nemavara, kwete kururamisa.
Mapeji akadhindwa anoshanda nemakirayoni akakura kana marker, anonyatsobatika.

faq.a: Kwete. Hapana kloko, mamaki, kauntarai yezvamakaita kana kukundikana. Imi munogona kumira panguva ipi neipi, uye kumira pakati ndiyo nzira yakanaka yekupedzisa.
Takadhirowa zvinhu zvakanyarara, zvakapfava kwete makatuni, saka mapeji akakodzera vakuru. Mifananidzo mikuru inoita kuti kupenda kuve nyore pasina kuita kuti kuite sevana.
Hongu, mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Zvinoshanda pawebhusaiti pafoni, pathabhureti kana pakombiyuta.

conversation-cards.name: Makadhi ekutaurirana
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Mabvunzo Ekutaurirana Ye Dementia: Makadhi Emifananidzo
conversation-cards.description: Makadhi emifananidzo ane mibvunzo yakapfava yekutaurirana vanhu vane dementia: hapana kubvunzwa mibvunzo, hapana mhinduro dzakarurama. Shandisa pachikwereti kana udhindire seti yose.
conversation-cards.short: Makadhi emifananidzo ane mibvunzo yakavhurika, yakapfava. Hapana kubvunzwa mibvunzo.
conversation-cards.intro: Kadhi rega rega rinobatanisa mufananidzo unozivikanwa nekukokwa kwakavhurika kutaura, somuenzaniso "Mamiriro ekunze awanda kwazvo ndeapi?" Hapana mhinduro dzakarurama uye hapana chinofanira kuyeuchidzwa. Sarudza musoro kana usanganise ese.
howTo: Sarudza musoro, kana gara uchiri "Makadhi ose".
Verenga mubvunzo nemutsindo, uye tarisai mufananidzo pamwe chete.
Teerera, goverana mhinduro yako, uye regedza kutaura kuchifamba.
Tinya "Kadhi rinotevera" kana wagadzirira, kana gara nekadhi rimwe chete sezvamunoda.
Tinya "Dhinda makadhi ese" kuti mutemerwe seti yepepa.
tips: Pindurai mubvunzo imi pachenyu zvakare. Zvinoita sekutaurirana, kwete kubvunzwa.
Tevera nyaya, kwete zvechokwadi. Kana tsananguro dzichishanduka, zviri zvakanaka.
Kana kadhi rikabata chinhu chinorwadza, bvuma manzwiro uye ufambe zvinyoro kuenda kukadhi rimwe.

faq.a: Mibvunzo inoedzera kuyeuka inogona kuita sebvunzo yechikoro uye kukonzera kunyadziswa. Mikokwa yakavhurika seya "Ndiudze nezvo…" inobvumira munhu wese kubatanidza, zvinoenderana nezvaanoyeuka.
Hongu. "Dhinda makadhi ese" inodhinda seti yose nemagwaro akakura, makadhi akawanda papeji rimwe, akagadzirira kucheka.
Hongu, hazvibhadharwi, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoreswa kana kudhawunirodha. Inoshanda mubhurawuza yewebhu pafoni, piritsi kana kombiyuta.

photo-pairs.name: Mapairi Emifananidzo
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Gadzira Mutambo Wekubatanidza Kubva Mumifananidzo Yemhuri
photo-pairs.description: Shandura mifananidzo yemhuri yako kuita mutambo wakanyorova wekubatanidza. Sarudza mifananidzo 2 kusvika 6 pachishandiso chako; inogara mubhurawuza yako uye haitumirwi kumusoro.
photo-pairs.short: Sarudza mifananidzo yako uiibatanidze. Hapana chinotumirwa.
photo-pairs.intro: Sarudza mifananidzo miviri kusvika mitanhatu kubva pafoni, piritsi kana kombiyuta yako, uye inova mutambo wekubatanidza une mifananidzo mikuru inoonekwa zvakanaka. Mifananidzo inoratidzwa mukati mepeji rino chete. Haitumirwi, haichengetwi, uye haigoverwi, uye inopera kana wavhara peji.
howTo: Pinza "Sarudza mifananidzo" uve nesarudzo yemifananidzo miviri kusvika mitanhatu.
Mufananidzo wega wega unoonekwa kaviri. Pinza imwe, wobva wapinza pari yayo.
Taura nezvemufananidzo wega wega paunoiwana.
Pakupedzisa, vhara peji kana pinza "Bvisa mifananidzo". Hapana chinochengetwa.
tips: Sarudza mifananidzo yakajeka yezvinhu zvinofadza uye zvinozivikanwa: mbwa, munda, nzvimbo yaunofarira, zuva rekuroora.
Mifananidzo yenzvimbo nezvinhu inogona kunge iri nyore kupfuura zviso, uye inobvisa kumanikidzwa kutaura mazita evanhu.
Regai mifananidzo yevanhu vakafa kana ichigona kuunza kurwadziwa kwadzo kwakasiyana, kunze kwekunge muchiziva kuti inounza rugare.

faq.a: Kwete. Peji rinoverenga mifananidzo yaunosarudza mubhurawuza yako rinoiratidza pachiratidzo chako. Haitumirwi kwatiri kana kune mumwe munhu, uye inopera kana wavhara kana kudzoka kupeji.
Kwete. Hapana wachi, mhedzisiro, kauntara yemigove, kana kurasikirwa. Unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi, uye kumira pakati pakati idzira yakanaka yekupedzisa.

faq.q: Ndinogona kuchengeta mutambo wenguva inotevera here?
faq.a: Kwete mubhurawuza, zvakanzi zvakaitwa, kuti pasava nezvakavanzika zvinochengetwa. Apuri yemahara yeGolden Moments yeiPhone neiPad inogona kuchengeta makopi emifananidzo yaunosarudza pachishandiso chako.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo Yemifananidzo
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo Yemifananidzo Yevakuru Vane Dementia: Inogona Kudhindwa
picture-bingo.description: Bingo yemifananidzo yakasununguka inogona kudhindwa yemapoka ekuchengetedza uye evakuru, ine munhu anoratidza mifananidzo pascreen huru. Mifananidzo mikuru ine mazita, zvikwere 9 kana 16, hapana kuverenga kunodiwa.
picture-bingo.short: Makadhi ebingo emifananidzo anogona kudhindwa uye muratidzi wescreen huru yemapoka.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo yakajairwa ine mifananidzo panzvimbo yenhamba, saka hapana munhu anofanira kuverenga mavara madiki. Dhindza seti yemakadhi akasiyana, wobva washandisa muratidzi pascreen kuratidza mufananidzo wega wega wakakura paTV, laputopu kana piritsi.
howTo: Sarudza zvikwere 9 kana 16 pakadhi rega rega, uye vanhu vangani vanotamba.
Pinza "Dhindza makadhi". Kadhi rega rega rakasiyana.
Vhura muratidzi pascreen huru. Pinza "Mufananidzo unotevera" kuratidza mufananidzo wega wega une zita rawo.
Vanotamba vanofukidza mufananidzo wakafanana pakadhi ravo nechinhu chidiki, batani kana chiratidzo.
Munhu wese anozadza mutsara, kana kadhi rese, anorumbidzwa nekuomba maoko. Muvhezheni ino hapana akarasikirwa: ramba uchitamba kusvika wose vane mutsara.
tips: Shandisa zvinhu zvikuru sematokeni akadai sezvipfeko zvekutamba kana zvibvu zvemabhodhoro. Mabhatani madiki anogona kuoma kutora.
Taura zita remufananidzo uye utaure zvishoma pamusoro pawo: "Ngarava yekufamba mugungwa. Ndiani akambofamba mungarava?"
Gadzira vanhu vane dambudziko rekuona pedyo nescreen, uye vabatanidze nevabatsiri vanovada.
Zvikwere zvepfumbamwe zvakakwana mapoka mazhinji. Ita kuti chikamu chiite maminitsi 20 kusvika 30.

faq.q: Ndinoita sei bingo yemifananidzo mumba yekuchengetedza?
faq.a: Dhindza kadhi rimwe chete pamunhu wega wega, isa muratidzi pascreen hombe yaunayo, uye udane mifananidzo zvishoma nezvishoma, uchitaura zita rega rega. Tamba kusvika wose vane mutsara, kuti hapana akasiyiwa.
Hongu. Dhindza makadhi akawanda sezvaunoda, kangani sezvaunoda, zvemushandisi pachake kana zvemapoka.

faq.q: Vanhu vanogona kutamba pasina kuverenga here?
faq.a: Hongu. Chikwere chega chega mufananidzo mukuru, nezita rawo pasi kune avo vanoda mashoko.

calm-breathing.name: Kufema Zvakanyorova
calm-breathing.description: Kumira kwakanyorova, kwakanaka kwekufema kugovana: denderedzwa rinokura uye rinodzika kwemafemo matanhatu. Iwe unotanga, uye unogona kumira nguva ipi neipi.
calm-breathing.short: Denderedzwa rinonyorova rekufema nariro. Tanga uye mira sezvaunoda.
calm-breathing.intro: Nguva dzimwe dzose mutambo wakanakisisa ndiko kumira kwakanyorova. Pinza "Tanga", wobva wafema mukati denderedzwa richikura uye kunze richidzika. Sarudza kufamba kwakanyanya kana kwakakurumidza. Haisi kurapwa, asi nguva yakanyorova yekugovana.
howTo: Garai pasi makomfoti pamwe chete.
Sarudza kufamba: kunyorova kana kwakanyanya.
Pinza "Tanga". Fema mukati denderedzwa richikura, uye kunze richidzika.
Rinomira rega rega pashure pemafemo matanhatu, kana pinza "Mira" nguva ipi neipi.
tips: Batana maoko kana uise ruoko pamaoko omunhu kana zvichifarirwa.
Usamanikidza. Kana vachida kungoona, zvakanaka.
Kana munhu ane dambudziko rekufema, fema zvakajairika uye ungotarisa denderedzwa chete. Bvunza chiremba pamusoro pechero dambudziko rekufema.

faq.q: Iri ndiro basa rekufema rekurapa here?
faq.a: Kwete. Ndiro kumira kwakapusa, kunoitwa kana uchida, nekuda kwerugare uye kuva pamwe chete. Haisi kurapwa kwekutya kana chirwere chipi zvacho. Taura nechiremba pamusoro penyaya dzehutano.

faq.q: Denderedzwa rinofamba here pasina kuti ini nditange?
faq.a: Kwete. Hapana chinofamba kusvika wadzanika Start, uye chinomira mushure mekufema kana matanhatu kana wadzanika Stop. Kana chishandiso chako chakagadzirwa kuderedza kufamba, mashoko anochinja asina denderedzwa kukura.
Hongu, mahara, uye hapana akaunzi, kunyoresa kana kudhawunirodha. Unoshanda mu web browser pafoni, patablet kana pakombiyuta.
